ablation: static favorable downside/upside residual-semivariance balance with positive residual trend
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier-A and Frontier-B 2016-2022 development results were observed before this campaign. Frontier-C is a new development research look, not a fresh holdout. 2023+ remains excluded from selection.
cost_hypothesis: weekly rebalancing plus state-transition features should reduce reaction to one-day noise; cost ladder is fixed before returns
failure_mode: mechanism collapses into an occupied level factor, generic trend, low volatility, or previously rejected delay formulation
falsifier: rotate signed-risk transition assignments across sorted asset labels while preserving each date's cross-sectional distribution
portfolio_role: orthogonal satellite only if destructive controls and matched residual diagnostics support independence
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Downside-risk and signed-volatility literature motivates separating adverse from favorable realized variation. The exact transition formula, universe handling, controls and portfolio construction are independently preregistered here; no published performance is imported.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed development floor; do not retune after failure
thesis: Falling downside semivariance relative to upside semivariance, while residual trend stays positive, marks improving risk quality rather than low volatility level.
timing: completed daily bars only; all transition states compare trailing estimates with a fixed 21-day-prior estimate
validation: 2023-2024 remains untouched during development selection; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
